visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair and bangs is in a bright indoor room, holding a large yellow POP MART box titled 'SAD CLUB'. She smiles at the camera, showing off the large collection box before beginning to unbox individual items. (2) The scene cuts rapidly as she holds individual triangular green and yellow boxes, peeling back the paper to reveal plush flower heads inside plastic bags. She displays an orange flower with a crying face. (3) She continues unboxing, showing a yellow flower and then posing with both the orange and yellow flowers together near her face. The background shows glass jars and kitchen-style shelving. (4) The unboxing continues with a purple flower featuring one eye closed and one open. She expresses high joy through wide eyes and smiles. (5) She reveals a blue flower, then two pink flowers with different facial expressions. She arranges the flowers into glass vases in the background. (6) Finally, she gathers all six flowers in her arms, showcasing the full set to the camera while smiling broadly.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with high pitch and rapid speed, introducing the unboxing. Upbeat acoustic guitar music plays at a moderate volume. (2) A 'pop' sound effect triggers a transition as she opens the first package, accompanied by the rustling of plastic bags and paper. Her voice rises in excitement. (3) Rapid 'whoosh' sound effects occur between short visual segments, punctuating each reveal. Her speech is constant and highly animated. (4) Distinct metallic clicks or object thuds are heard as she handles the plush items and places them in glass containers. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (5) A final bright 'ding' SFX marks the end of the unboxing as she presents the final set, with her vocal tone remaining positive and high-energy.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Successive Unboxing -> Final Reveal.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share the personal joy and detailed visual reveal of a full set of POP MART Crybaby plush flowers through an energetic unboxing vlog.
